Armstrong y Aldrin los dejaron en la Lun: Armstrong and Aldrin left them on the Moon in 1969 to save weight for liftoff.
El soporte vital de las caminatas lunare: Life support for the moonwalks. It was left behind before liftoff.
Las cámaras se quedaron en la Luna: solo: The cameras stayed on the Moon: only the film magazines came back.
Alan Shepard golpeó dos pelotas en la Lu: Alan Shepard hit two golf balls on the Moon during Apollo 14 (1971).
Charlie Duke dejó una foto de su familia: Charlie Duke left a photo of his family on the Moon (Apollo 16, 1972).
El visor dorado protegía los ojos del So: The gold visor protected the eyes from the Moon's unfiltered sunlight. The helmets came home; many other things did not.
